name: Marker Detect
description: Official intro/outro/credits marker detector. Subscribes to media.marker.detect; maps Host probeSummary (chapters + head/tail silence/black windows from FFmpeg) into core media_markers candidates. No bare storage paths.

permissions.reason: Receive media.marker.detect sync jobs and probe summaries for intro/credits heuristics.
Optional Host item reads when debugging detect results.
Optional Host PUT markers path for async follow-ups; sync path returns markers to core.

configSchema.label: Emit plain chapters
configSchema.helpText: When true, also emit markerType=chapter for untitled/non-intro chapters (default false).
